utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries — once I hear the final details, I’ll pass them along right away. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can help sort donations and load boxes. Want me to note the repair stop addresses too?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes please — jot down the repair stop addresses and keep sorting the donations. Thanks, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll sort the donations and write down the repair stop addresses too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it, Mara — I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts, and I’ll help keep an eye on the donations by the main entrance too.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — just let me know what you find out. I’m happy to help once we know what’s still needed.

utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it sounds like the repair drive’s really coming together—folks are already bringing in tools and spare parts. If I hear what they still need, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I’m headed out soon, so I’ll ask around too and report back if I hear anything useful for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Ira — that’d be great. I’ll keep an ear out here too and let you know if I hear what they still need.

utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it simple today. Tell me what still needs fixing, and I’ll see what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you jot down the exact location for each repair stop? I’m keeping the drive organized by address and timing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes — I can do that. Send me the addresses and times, and I’ll write them down as simply as I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — that would be a big help. I’ll send out the updated list for Sunday at the community center, and we can see what supplies are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Rosa. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and pass along anything useful right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep the list updated for Sunday at the community center and let everyone know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really helpful — I’ll pass that along and keep an ear out for any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate that. I’ll keep listening and pass along anything I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll send the locations over when I have them. Thanks, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll send the spots over soon. Appreciate it — either supplies or a stop works.

utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m happy to help out, though I may need a reminder on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll spread the word and bring my tools. If you need a refresher, I can also tell folks we’re still gathering tools, time, and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — that’d help a lot. I’m still fuzzy on the details, so a quick reminder about what we need most would be great.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks — I can help with whatever’s still left to fix. Just let me know what you want me to tackle.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Rey — could you take the small fixes and I’ll handle the drill work? We should have everything covered at the repair drive.

utterances.text: Faye: Sunday at the community center works for me — what time window are you using? I can help fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can help during that 9 to 11 window. If you need, I can take a simple shift or help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — send me the locations when you have them, and I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive.

utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the details first and send the locations once I have them. What do we know so far about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just that Rey can help with the repairs and Dane can bring whatever’s needed. Once you send the locations, I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I might’ve missed the latest update again—what changed about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I just want to confirm whether the repair drive is still happening before I tell anyone. Can you check and let me know when you’re sure?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check the latest and let you know as soon as I’m sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Jules — are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — 10 still stands, and I’ll let you know if anything changes. Thanks for being ready to help with the small household fixes!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll keep 10 open and wait for your update.
